name: MK Seiko Co., Ltd.
summary: MK Seiko Co., Ltd. develops, makes and sells automotive service and information technology equipment as well as household consumer goods. Its automotive products include car mat washers, tire inflation devices, automated machines for cleaning cars and vehicle washing systems, plus equipment for fluid and oil management. Its home line includes cooking appliances and storage solutions. Dating from 1956, it has its headquarters in Chikuma, Japan.
